The '''Skine sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] close to the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Lucrenn]], [[Skine]], [[Skynara]], and [[Wodenstam]]. It was one endpoint for the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils' Tour]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], serviced by the [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury star yacht]] ''[[Veil of Skynara]]''. The sector was home to significant [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity as well as the criminal [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]].

==Description==
The Skine sector was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="GG11" /> nearby the [[Lybeya system/Legends|Lybeya system]] of the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]].<ref name="SE">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> It was bordered [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] by the [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris]], [[Dail sector/Legends|Dail]], [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol]], [[Merel sector/Legends|Merel]], [[Samix sector/Legends|Samix]], and [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sectors]].<ref name="Outer Rim Extra">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/atlas/news20090910/index.html|text=''Essential Atlas'' Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Lucrenn]], [[Wodenstam]],<ref name="GG11" /> [[Skine]],<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> and [[Skynara]]. The sector was also the end point for the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils' Tour]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]], which ran from Skynara to [[Farstine]], a [[Methane/Legends|methane]] world.<ref name="GG9" />

==History==
During the period of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury space yacht]] ''[[Veil of Skynara]]'' made regular cruises and short trips along the Five Veils' Tour, carrying aboard a renowned [[Balved Sculpture]] that was also called the [[Veil of Skynara (sculpture)|Veil of Skynara]]. The high number of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in the Skine sector caused a drop in the yacht's passenger numbers. In order to offset this and to ensure its security, the yacht was escorted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the final leg of its journey.<ref name="GG9" /> The Five Veils' Tour was also used by [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] traveling to the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]].<ref name="Atlas" />

[[File:Tenloss.svg|thumb|left|upright|The Tenloss Syndicate]]
In addition to Rebel presence, Skine sector was also home to a number of criminal enterprises affiliated with the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]]. Known as one of the largest non-[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal organizations in the Outer Rim, Tenloss was founded in the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]], but subsequently spread into not only the Skine, but also the [[Astal sector/Legends|Astal]], [[Dail sector/Legends|Dail]], and [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sectors]]. Involved in a diverse range of criminal activities, Tenloss affiliates in the Skine sector included [[Galindas Exports]] and [[Lucross Collections]]. Galindas Exports was centered on the planet Lucrenn, running "mass-market" fencing operations and passing the stolen good off to various [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] guilds. In addition to Lucrenn, Galindas also maintained a large processing network<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> and a number of secret [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] bases throughout the sector.<ref name="GG11" /> Tenloss funneled a large volume of stolen goods from the nearby Lybeya system through Galindas.<ref name="SE" /> A highly centralized business, Lucross Collections gained a reputation for its overzealous agents, and operated out of Wodenstam. It was also involved in [[loan shark]]ing and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] laundering.<ref name="GG11" />

The Skine sector was also home to the [[Skine Bounty Hunter College]] located on the planet Skine. Despite its name, the College was not a training institute, but rather a loosely affiliated network of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Spy/Legends|spies]], smugglers, and other informants. Operating throughout the Empire, as well as in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the Skine Bounty Hunter College specialized in tracking down targets that had a track record of evading Imperial capture. Its chief executive council preferred working with individual corporations and private citizens, using highly specialized hunters to track down their targets.<ref name="GG10" /> Also operating in the sector was the [[Ragnar Syndicate]], a large [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|bounty hunter guild]] originally founded in the [[Merel sector/Legends|Merel sector]].<ref name="GG9" />

By the time of the [[New Sith]] Empire, Skynara and the Skine sector were one of the few regions that were still influenced by the remnant of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skine sector was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[West End Games]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] sourcebook published in [[1993]], and was subsequently expanded on in later sourcebooks in the ''[[Galaxy Guide]]'' series. The sector was also featured in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]], although no new systems were placed within its bounds.
